page.overview:
What is Mithrellas?

Mithrellas was a Silvan Elf who, according to the tradition of the House of Dol Amroth, accompanied Nimrodel from Lothlórien on her journey to Edhellond. Mithrellas, it is said, became lost in the woods of Belfalas, where she was found by Imrazôr the Númenórean, who married her. So Elvish blood entered the line of the Princes of Dol Amroth, it was claimed, and her son Galador became the first of the long line of Princes. Mithrellas also bore Imrazôr a daughter, Gilmith.

Mithrellas was a Sindarin name of unknown meaning. Its roots may be mith, which can be interpreted as both "grey" and "mist", rein, renia or revia, which can be interpreted as "wandering", "track" or "sail", and las, meaning "leaf" (especially pertaining to trees).

It is possible that her name merely combined mithren, meaning "grey", with las , "leaf", to simply mean "grey leaf".
